knownGaps: D52, NOT fixed, disclosed rather than silently patched: this spec's own `shell` field has always said 'none — full-bleed celebratory moment, minimal/no chrome,' but web/src/app/[locale]/app/layout.tsx wraps every /app/* route (this one included) in the same AppShell (sidebar + topbar) unconditionally — there is no existing mechanism to fully hide the shell (only Course Player's SidebarForceCollapseContext, which COLLAPSES to 72px, never removes). Closing this gap requires either a new SidebarForceHiddenContext (a small extension of an already-approved pattern) or a route-level layout exception, both of which touch the shared shell every /app/* screen depends on — out of scope for a targeted, low-risk visual pass; needs an explicit go-ahead before touching shared shell code.
